title: Artificial Intelligence and Digital Services
label: AI & Digital
intro: We help public institutions, businesses and NGOs understand and use technology in a practical and responsible way. Tools are tested for accuracy, security and performance in Pashto and Dari, and important decisions stay under human oversight.
examples: Introductory and advanced AI training for leaders and staff
Assessment of AI readiness, needs and suitable uses
Advice on digital workflows, data management and technology selection
AI-supported document search, knowledge management, analysis, translation and reporting
Design and testing of supervised AI assistants for defined tasks
Staff guidance, operating procedures and implementation support
